name: tubulin gamma complex component 6

function.text: TUBGCP6 is the approved symbol for tubulin gamma complex component 6. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in gamma-tubulin binding; microtubule binding; cytoplasmic microtubule organization.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include microcephaly and chorioretinopathy 1 (autosomal recessive). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma; Low-grade glioma; Prostate adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: TUBGCP6 encodes tubulin gamma complex component 6. It forms part of the gamma-tubulin ring complex (gTuRC) which mediates microtubule nucleation. The gTuRC regulates the minus-end nucleation of alpha-beta tubulin heterodimers that grow into microtubule protafilaments, a critical step in centrosome duplication and spindle formation.

germline.text: Germline disease associations include microcephaly and chorioretinopathy 1 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TUBGCP6 have been reported in low-grade glioma, prostate adenocarcinoma, and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
